transcript.text: Good morning everyone. As we all know, Echo Chamber is scheduled to open to the public this Saturday, and I have final authority to approve the operating plan. Before I can sign off, we need to go through our standard opening procedure — I'd like to hear from each of our leads: technical, rights, accessibility, and risk. Please report any confirmed requirements you have so we can review the current draft plan together. For reference, the draft currently allows 12 visitors per session, permits visitor photography, uses one general admission queue, and assigns one floor attendant. Who would like to start?
